harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: WebDAV is operational at http://node1:8080/documents/. The editor account has full document CRUD access, anonymous access is denied, exclusive locks prevent tokenless overwrites, source documents remain preserved, and service/data recovery after a node restart was verified.
actions_performed: Installed AlmaLinux-compatible Apache WebDAV packages without changing the OS release or kernel
Created a separate writable WebDAV workspace populated from the supplied project documents
Configured editor-only authentication, persistent SELinux permissions, firewall access, and automatic service startup
Verified authenticated create, read, replace, and delete operations
Verified exclusive LOCK enforcement before and after restart
Safely restarted node1 and confirmed changed boot identity, service recovery, data persistence, and final cleanup

evidence.requirement: WebDAV workspace at /documents/ on TCP 8080 with supplied documents
evidence.summary: httpd is enabled and active, listens on TCP 8080, and PROPFIND lists brief.txt and budget.csv.

evidence.requirement: Editor can create, read, replace, and delete documents
evidence.summary: Direct HTTP results show PUT 201, GET 200, replacement PUT 204 with updated content, DELETE 204, and subsequent GET 404.

evidence.requirement: Exclusive locks prevent overwrites without the lock token
evidence.summary: Before and after restart, exclusive LOCK succeeded, tokenless PUT returned 423 without changing content, and token-authorized PUT succeeded.

evidence.requirement: Anonymous clients cannot access the workspace
evidence.summary: Anonymous GET consistently returned HTTP 401, including after restart and in final state.

evidence.requirement: Initial project documents remain preserved in /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks
evidence.summary: Initial and final SHA-256 hashes match; the preserved source and final workspace documents compare identically.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel remain unchanged
evidence.summary: AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 were unchanged through deployment and restart.

Healthy baseline used boot ID e65e6bcf-e09d-42b7-8317-cb6310086cb7; the native reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 4c0ba9f4-be46-4349-944f-6e88264d27a4; service, firewall, authentication, documents, persistence marker, and locking all recovered.
